HARD-ONS WITH JERRY A
AUSTRALIAN TOUR MARCH 2027

Australian punk rock legends the Hard-Ons are hitting the road in March 2027 for an extensive national tour, joined by hardcore punk royalty Jerry A of iconic US outfit Poison Idea on lead vocals. The tour follows the release of their collaborative album in 2026.

Formed in 1982, the Hard-Ons have spent over four decades carving out a reputation as one of Australia's most influential and explosive live bands, blending punk, heavy metal, power pop and psychedelia into their own unmistakable sound.

Now entering an exciting new chapter with Jerry A at the helm, the Hard-Ons remain as relentless and infectious as ever. Armed with a legendary back catalogue spanning over four decades, the band continue to push forward with the same ferocious energy that has earned them a devoted following around the world.

The Hard-Ons with Jerry A, live across Australia this March.

March 4 - Link & Pin, Woy Woy
March 5 - Ed Castle, Adelaide
March 6 - Milk Bar, Perth
March 7 - The River, Margaret River
March 10 - Dissent, Canberra
March 11 - Barwon Club, Geelong
March 12 - The Tote, Melbourne
March 13 - Singing Bird, Frankston
March 14 - Altar, Hobart
March 18 - The Hamo, Newcastle
March 19 - Paddo RSL, Sydney
March 20 - Vinnies Dive, Gold Coast
March 21 - The Brightside, Brisbane
